name: Aerion Grant
source:
The ward from the Grants. [url=/c146901]Cerys[/url] says she's pretty short for an orran, but still taller than most humans. Orran culture prioritizes strength and power, with special emphasis on intelligence and physical size. Cerys indicated that Aerion, like all other shorter orrans, has been subjected to bullying and shaming as a result of her height.

Cerys believes that Aerion is being sent to the Gryms for her wardship because her parents want to move her out of that demeaning environment. Cerys asked that I make special mention of Aerion during my speech at the ball, since she's the ward most likely to be replaced after the announcement of my Affinity.

[In game description]
